summary: The household's hunter (HuntJob: the logic, scripts/companion/hunt_job.gd; HuntRun: the body in the level, hunt_run.gd). The hunt job (jobs.json 'hunt': outside, by day, pulled along the chain by the meals / jerky / leather / furs shortages through the butcher) reads sign with the survival core's own hunt.track (the Hunting check, its time and its growth), picks a live animal of the quarry species within the reveal radius of that outcome, stalks it crouched (the animals notice her by sight, footfall and scent as they notice the player, less for her Hunting), and shoots from her shot distance: the chance to hit and to place the ball or arrow in the heart and lungs is shot_odds (her weapon skill and Hunting against the distance over the weapon's range and what the animal is doing), and the hit itself is a real ray through the animal's hit zones delivered with Hit.deliver (the wound is where it went through: WildAnimal.wound_at), the report heard by the wildlife (WildlifeSpawner.shot: the herd bolts, a miss scares them). A kill is hauled home on a rope (CarcassLoad, as the player drags one) to be butchered at home, or, too far, too heavy or stuck, field-dressed where it lies and the meat and hide carried home. Wolves near: she comes home, and fires at one that closes if she has a shot. Design values (basis D) unless noted.

weapons.name: musket
weapons.note: the ball: ballistics.json musket damage 120; its sure range for a man in the woods about 60 m, a long shot 110

weapons.name: pistol
weapons.note: a horse pistol: a poor hunting arm, short and weak (ballistics.json pistol); taken only when there is no long gun

weapons.name: bow
weapons.note: a full draw: ballistics.json bow 30-90; the bow is silent and wants a close shot (backgrounds.json note, Y:3.8)

weapons.name: throwing spears
weapons.note: the throwing spears (ballistics.json spear 60-130): she must get within 10-15 m (shot_frac of range_m: 14 m for a novice, 10.5 for the best), a throw, less sure on deer and better on small game; a spear that kills is found again, one that misses most often

settle_find.note: the arrow or spear of a shot looked for (HuntJob.settle): the weapon's recover times this: in the kill, lying past a miss, gone with a wounded animal

stalk.crouch_aim_note: HuntRun._stance: she aims crouched when the animal is this close or a trunk stands just before her on its line (cover), standing in the open (the weapon's stand_aim clip)

lines.shot_hit: %s hits the %s at %d m; it runs.
lines.hauled: %s drags a %s home to be butchered.
lines.hauled_self: %s drags a %s home and dresses it: %s.
lines.horse: %s brings a %s home behind the horse to be butchered.
lines.cart: %s brings a %s home in the cart to be butchered.
lines.barrow: %s wheels a %s home in the barrow to be butchered.
lines.quartered: %s quarters a %s and carries it home in %d trips: %s.
lines.no_kit: no gun, bow or spears with shot for them in the house

kit.note: What the hunter takes out of the household's own things (HuntKit: the tool pool, the racks and the chests), carries while out and brings back: the weapon she is best at that has shot for it, its shot for the trip, a knife to dress the kill, and a meal for the trip (eaten when she is hungry out there). What she did not use goes back where it came from. The job's own declaration is jobs.json hunt `tools` (need, optional, use_by, food); these lists are its fallback (a worker with no household pool).

transport.note: How a kill comes home (HuntHaul, scripts/companion/hunt_haul.gd; user 2026-09-29: 'if they are smart they will use a household wheelbarrow or horse to drag the carcass or put the carcass in the wagon/wheelbarrow to save time'). choose(): a smart hunter (smart() >= smart_min: weights of her Hunting and Woodcraft (0..100 each), kill per kill she has made up to kills_max, her recruit traits) uses the household's transport that is free at home (within home_r of the hearth), in this order: the horse (fetched when the kill lies within horse_fetch_m of home, led out and the carcass dragged home on its rope: HorseLead, HorseHaul), the horse with the cart (HorseCart: the horse put to it at home; the carcass in the bed; the cart takes a bison), the wheelbarrow (a kill of barrow_max_kg or less: a deer whole; fetched from home within barrow_fetch_m, or the one a hunter of plan_barrow or more took out with her when her stalk began, from within near_home_m of her, and left where she crouched). Otherwise she drags it by hand (HuntDrag, drag_max_kg and haul.max_home_m at most), or dresses it where it lies and carries the meat home: its meat (meat_share of kg) carry_kg a trip, at most max_trips ('quarter': a quarter a trip). Transport is used only when free (nobody riding, leading, pushing or loading it, not another worker's: meta hunt_by), is reserved while she has it, and is put back where it stood. kg: the kill's weight where the horse's haul.json has none (a bison; a cow about 450 kg, a bull 700-900: from memory, not checked against a source here). Design values (basis D).

ride.note: RIDING (user 2026-09-29: 'if the horse is available they should ride the horse for the hunt', 'park it far enough out of the animal's sight', 'saddle the carcass and head home'): a hunter with the horse free at home rides it out (a grown worker; the young lead it) when the quarry is more than ride_min_m beyond where she leaves it: HuntRide.park_distance, out of the quarry's sight of a rider when it is most watchful (its sight x 1.5 x 1.4, WildAnimal._sense_body) and of the sound of the horse (35 m x its hearing), and park_margin_m more. A rider lays a kill of ride_pack_max_kg or less behind the saddle across the horse's hindquarters and rides home (user 2026-09-30: 'they cannot ride the horse back?'); the young, who lead, lay one of pack_max_kg or less across the saddle; a heavier one goes on the rope, ridden home. Design values (basis D; a saddle horse packs about a fifth of its weight, some 90-110 kg, from memory).
